issue.positionEn: Follow clothing, sound, objects and cities to examine how material, making and the conditions of looking change a work.
issue.introEn: A familiar piece of furniture changes material; a photograph changes support; a new record brings playing and words into another conversation. Follow clothing, records, booths and rooms to examine how works are made and how they enter looking and use.
issue.closingEn: Look closely at the material, then leave the work a little time.
